Method of Attack: RDP brute-force attacks to gain initial access
Manual installation of ransomware on compromised systems
File encryption using RC4 and RSA-1024 algorithms
Dropping ransom note text files across filesystem
Impacted Systems: NHS Lanarkshire board hospitals including Hairmyres Hospital, Monklands Hospital, Wishaw General Hospital
Attack Vector: RDP brute-force attacks on exposed endpoints
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note text files dropped on infected systems
Ransom note text content demanding Bitcoin payment
